visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a panning shot of a long queue of people dressed in casual summer wear, waiting in a brightly lit shopping mall with white tiled floors. (2) A close-up shows a restaurant signage 'Kyoto Ramen Kairikiya' followed by more shots of the crowd being managed by red velvet ropes. (3) The main character, a young Asian man in a white t-shirt, is seen talking directly to the camera inside a vehicle and then standing outside the Shinkong Mitsukoshi department store in Tainan, pointing towards the entrance. (4) A series of extreme close-ups showcase the preparation and presentation of ramen, including noodles being lifted from a bowl, slices of chashu pork, and seasoned eggs in a rich soy-based broth with fat droplets. (5) The man is shown eating the noodles enthusiastically with chopsticks in a well-lit restaurant setting, interspersed with shots of kitchen staff shaking noodles and adding toppings. (6) Various condiments and side dishes like chashu rice with melted cheese are displayed in close-ups, with the creator continuing to eat with high energy. (7) The video concludes with the man showing the empty ramen bowl and reacting with an excited expression in front of the store's interior signage.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 才剛開店三分鐘就排成這樣!?. [Logo]: @sanyuan_japan. (2) [Subtitle]: 最近在台灣新開的「這家」拉麵店. (3) [Subtitle]: 真的太猛了!. (4) [Subtitle]: 你知道日本人心中最愛的拉麵是哪一間嗎?. (5) [Subtitle]: 第一名其實不是一蘭喔. (6) [Subtitle]: 而「這家店」居然在台南的新光三越小北門店開幕了!. (7) [Subtitle]: 「這家店」的特色是嚴選雞骨熬煮加上香濃的背脂『極品湯頭』. (8) [Subtitle]: 搭配的是中細直麵. (9) [Subtitle]: 再加上叉燒、糖心蛋、青蔥口味清爽卻又充滿濃郁深度. (10) [Subtitle]: 用的還是京都熟成醬油. (11) [Subtitle]: 這碗醬油拉麵真的每天吃都吃不膩!. (12) [Subtitle]: 真的會讓你...筷子停不下來!. (13) [Subtitle]: 不只有經典醬油拉麵還有豚骨拉麵、雞白湯拉麵也超好吃. (14) [Subtitle]: 超適合跟朋友點不同口味互相分享. (15) [Subtitle]: 而且套餐的選擇也非常豐富像這個炙燒丼飯超有人氣. (16) [Subtitle]: 我也點來吃吃看了...超級好吃. (17) [Subtitle]: 光這碗飯就值回這家店的價值了!. (18) [Subtitle]: 這麼強的「這家」拉麵店拉麵控還不快衝一波. (19) [Subtitle]: 它在日本已經開超過150間分店是排行榜上第一名的超人氣名店-. (20) [Subtitle]: 就是「拉麵魁力屋」. (21) [Subtitle]: 趕快分享給你最愛吃拉麵的朋友吧!.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, upbeat electronic pop BGM featuring a driving four-on-the-floor drum beat. The male narrator speaks with a bright, enthusiastic tone at a rapid pace. (2) A sharp 'Impact' SFX marks a transition to the shop introduction. Faint ambient chatter of a mall crowd is audible underneath the narration. (3) 'Whoosh' sounds are used frequently as the visual cuts quickly between ramen preparation shots. The vocal pitch rises to emphasize key features of the food. (4) Distinct wet slurping sounds are heard as the creator eats, synchronized with the video, alongside the percussive 'Clack' of chopsticks. (5) A 'Ding' bell sound plays to highlight a specific text achievement on screen. (6) The BGM volume slightly ducks during detailed descriptions of the broth and ingredients but remains continuous throughout. (7) The narration concludes with a high-energy call to action over a swell in the BGM before a quick fade out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Location Introduction -> Food Showcase -> Tasting Review -> Brand Credentials -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the opening of a new 'Kyoto Ramen Kairikiya' branch in Tainan, highlighting its popularity, high ranking in Japan, and the quality of its ramen and side sets.
